content.text:
=== Backend health via management port 8081 (as compose healthcheck does) ===
{"detail":"No static resource actuator/health.","instance":"/actuator/health","status":404,"title":"Not Found"}
=== docker exec: spring-app /health on 8081 ===
8081/health: 200
{"groups":["liveness","readiness"],"status":"UP"}
=== spring-app container health state ===
healthy

observation.command:
echo "=== Backend health via management port 8081 (as compose healthcheck does) ==="
curl -s --max-time 20 -H "Host: api.workspace.localhost" http://127.0.0.1:80/actuator/health 2>/dev/null | head -c 200; echo
echo "=== docker exec: spring-app /health on 8081 ==="
docker exec urbo-workspace-spring-app-1 sh -c 'curl -s -o /dev/null -w "8081/health: %{http_code}\n" http://127.0.0.1:8081/health; curl -s http://127.0.0.1:8081/health 2>/dev/null | head -c 120; echo' 2>&1 | head
echo "=== spring-app container health state ==="
docker inspect --format '{{.State.Health.Status}}' urbo-workspace-spring-app-1
